findings.problem: The hint 'a group that decides' does not rule out el concejo, the usual Latin American word for a town or city council ('concejo municipal'), which sounds the same as consejo, and it also fits la junta or el comité.
findings.fix: hint: a governing or advisory body, like a student or security council (not a town council)

back.es: council, board (a body that governs or advises); also advice

note: Learners may confuse consejo with the homophone concejo (town council), so a short contrast on the back of the card could help.
